capabilities: Render Mermaid diagrams from Base note properties
Add layout, timeline, numeric, and aggregate chart views to Bases
Configure diagrams via view settings and Mermaid config directives
Display images and Lucide icons in diagram labels via formulas
Style diagrams with CSS snippets and --mermaid-* variables
disambiguation: Does not render Mermaid code blocks written in notes; it generates diagrams from Base data without writing Mermaid syntax.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or newer; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Warns that external image requests expose your IP address to image hosts.
intentEvidence: Open a Base and add one of the Mermaid view types.
problem: Obsidian Bases only offers tabular views, so visualizing note relationships, dates, or numbers as diagrams would otherwise require hand-writing Mermaid code.
summary: Adds Mermaid diagram view types (flowchart, mindmap, timeline, Gantt, charts) to Obsidian Bases, generated from note properties.
